purpose: Context KB for camt.055.001.08 Customer Payment Cancellation Request V08 validation (CBPR+ SR2026). For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and fix suggestions, plus ISO 20022 / CBPR+ formal rules.

iso_20022_rules.name: RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl
iso_20022_rules.description: If CopyDuplicate is present, then Related MUST be present. Related MUST contain the relevant BusinessApplicationHeader elements of the BusinessMessage to which this BusinessMessage relates.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrGroupCaseRule
iso_20022_rules.description: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level (only one). Ensures uniqueness of the case across levels.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for uniqueness of case.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrPaymentInformationCaseRule
iso_20022_rules.description: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level (only one).
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for uniqueness of case.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrTransactionCaseRule
iso_20022_rules.description: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level (only one).
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for uniqueness of case.

iso_20022_rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
iso_20022_rules.description: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction; the SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline (message-level SupplementaryData is removed).

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationAndReasonRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is true, then OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/CancellationReasonInformation/Reason must be present.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for cancellation reason information in case of group cancellation.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationAndNumberOfTransactionsRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then NumberOfTransactions must equal the number of occurrences of TransactionInformation.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for number of transactions.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationTrueAndPaymentInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is true, then OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group cancellation and payment information.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationFalseAndPaymentInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation must be present.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group cancellation and payment information.

iso_20022_rules.name: PaymentInformationCancellationTrueAndTransactionInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/PaymentInformationCancellation is true, then TransactionInformation is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group cancellation and transaction information.

iso_20022_rules.name: PaymentInformationCancellationFalseAndTransactionInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/PaymentInformationCancellation is false, then TransactionInformation must be present.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for negative group cancellation and transaction information.

iso_20022_rules.name: BICFI
iso_20022_rules.description: Valid BICs for financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority and consist of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDBICFIPattern
iso_20022_rules.description: XSD BICFIDec2014Identifier pattern (camt.055.001.12): [A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})? — applies to Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt, Assgnmt/Assgne/Agt, AppHdr/Fr, AppHdr/To.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDDateTimeFormat
iso_20022_rules.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm (ISODateTime) and AppHdr/CreDt must use CBPR+ format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. No Z suffix, no milliseconds.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDv12Changes
iso_20022_rules.description: camt.055.001.12 (vs 001.08): Root element is CustomerPaymentCancellationRequestV12. Assgnmt/Assgnr and Assgnmt/Assgne accept Agt (agent) or Pty (party). CancellationReason3Choice uses ExternalCancellationReason1Code (4 chars) or Prtry (Max35Text). OrgnlClrSysRef added to TransactionInformation (new in v12). CtrlData element added at root level to carry NbOfTxs and CtrlSum.

iso_20022_rules.name: DuplicateIdentifierValue
iso_20022_rules.description: Identifiers required to be unique within a message (e.g. InstrId, TxId, EndToEndId, UETR) must not repeat across transactions or collide with GrpHdr/MsgId.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Identifier value is duplicated within the message.

iso_20022_rules.name: BicNotInDirectory
iso_20022_rules.description: Each BICFI should resolve to a registered institution in the official BIC directory.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: BIC/SWIFT code is not recognized in the official directory.

iso_20022_rules.name: MissingLeiAdvisory
iso_20022_rules.description: Under SR2026 a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is highly recommended for all financial institutions.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Agent FinInstnId is missing a recommended LEI.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must precede the Document element.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match Assignment/Assigner/Agent BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match Assignment/Assignee/Agent BIC, except where AppHdr/CopyDuplicate = COPY or CODU.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match Assignment/Assigner/Agent BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match Assignment/Assignee/Agent BIC when AppHdr/CopyDuplicate is absent.
Assigner and Assignee must be identified with a BICFI (via Agent/FinInstnId/BICFI); other elements are optional. The Assigner is the sender; the Assignee is the receiver.

The camt.055 must contain one Cancellation Request only. Underlying (Undrlyg) max occurrence reduced to 1 and OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/TransactionInformation reduced to a single occurrence (R[1..1]).

Underlying/OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/TransactionInformation/Case is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). Note: message-level Case building block is removed, so the Case is carried at transaction level (consistent with the Case-uniqueness rules R4/R5/R6).
Underlying/OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/TransactionInformation/OriginalEndToEndIdentification is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1).
TransactionInformation/CancellationReasonInformation/Reason is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). CancellationReasonInformation is reduced to a single occurrence (R[1..1]).
CancellationReasonInformation/Originator is populated only if different from the Case Creator.

For agents: if BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, then Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed (ClrSysMmbId and LEI may complement); BICFI takes precedence on conflict. If BICFI is absent, (Nm & PstlAdr) OR [(Nm & PstlAdr) and ClrSysMmbId] must be present; exception: when Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent and all agents in between are within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.
If the transaction is exchanged on the SWIFT network (instructing agent/sender and instructed agent/receiver are on SWIFT), then BICFI is mandatory and other elements (e.g. LEI) are optional.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' (SR2025). This element is mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). Datatype changed to UsageIdentifierPatternText.
AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must contain the Message Identification of the underlying message where available; otherwise the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance, i.e. 'camt.055.001.08'.
All proprietary/text fields (excl. Nm/Adr for all actors and RmtInf) limited to FIN-X charset. Nm/Adr/RmtInf and proxy email extended with !#$%&*=^_`{|}~";<>@[\] (< as <, > as >).

AppHdr/CreDt uses CBPR_DateTime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset; Z suffix forbidden. NOTE: Assignment/CreationDateTime uses ISODateTime under CGI-MP_ISODateTime_TextualRule (local time with UTC offset preferred; UTC 'Z' format permitted; 3 decimal fraction digits) — the Z restriction does NOT apply to Assgnmt/CreDtTm.
BranchIdentification is removed from agent FinInstnId blocks (AppHdr Fr/To agents, Related Fr/To agents, Assigner/Assignee agents and transaction agents) under CBPR+ SR2025.
Removed under CBPR+ SR2025 include: AppHdr/BizPrcgDt, AppHdr/Sgntr, the message-level Case building block, the ControlData building block, and message-level SupplementaryData.

The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this field must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

The Message Definition Identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header. In general, it must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance.
If related BAH is present, then it is recommended to transport the element Business Service.
Original Message Identification should transport the Message Identification of the underlying payment (e.g. pain.001 or pain.008).
This element should be only populated by the "Originator" otherwise can be populated with "NOTPROVIDED".
Original Message Name Identification should transport the Message Name Identification of the underlying payment (e.g. pain.001 or pain.008)
Either OriginalRequestedExecutionDate or OriginalRequestedCollectionDate must be present, but both can't be present.
For the Case/Identification, the below restrictions apply: - The first one and the 16th one cannot be “/” and - The string of 16 characters cannot contain “//”
Data present in structured elements within the Postal Address must not, under any circumstances be repeated in AddressLine.

(Clearing Code OR LEI) AND (Name AND ([Structured postal address with minimum Town Name and Country] OR [Hybrid postal address with minimum Town Name and Country]). It is recommended to also add the post code when available.
Whenever Debtor Agent and Creditor Agent are located within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.
Name AND ([Structured postal address with minimum Town Name and Country] OR [Hybrid postal address with minimum Town Name and Country]). It is recommended to also add the post code when available.
BICFI, complemented optionally with a LEI (preferred option)
Name and Address must always be present together.
If Reason code = NARR, then Additional Information is mandatory.
CancellationReasonInformation/Originator will be populated only if different from Case Creator.
